column4: NAMED: urllib vs net/http error text (same rc, ERROR: request failed: prefix, stdout); reset mid-headers Python ACCEPTED, Go refuses (stricter); ftp redirect Python followed, Go stops at the 3xx; header block over 100 lines (the blank counts) or a line over 65536 bytes: Python HTTPException traceback (rc1, stderr), Go ERROR: request failed (rc1, stdout); an h2-only ALPN server is reached as HTTP/1.1 because no ALPN is offered, as urllib; NAMED stricter: a followed Location that urllib would re-quote or re-assemble (non-printable or non-ASCII byte, space, brackets, uppercase scheme, netloc without path, empty ?, # or ;) (or one net/http cannot parse, e.g. a control character: "malformed MIME header", rc1) is refused with "location needs re-quote" (rc1) where Python follows the rewritten URL
NAMED: Python IncompleteRead is an uncaught traceback (rc1, stderr); Go prints ERROR: request failed (rc1, stdout)
HTTP error statuses are data, as in Python
NAMED: the UnicodeDecodeError text (byte, position, reason) differs; the 8192-byte chunk rule is the same

column4: NAMED: Go also refuses brackets, userinfo, ports above 65535 and non-host characters in the netloc (Python accepted; its request then failed or died); stderr not stdout
NAMED: Go refuses argparse abbreviations and -h (rc2); usage text differs, the message after 'error: ' equals
NAMED: Go refuses redirect source/target paths outside [A-Za-z0-9._~!$&'()*+,;=@/-] (a NUL, a space, a query, a fragment, %); Python requested them or died with InvalidURL

header values are read from the raw bytes with http.client/email compat32 rules (trailing space/tab kept, folding, duplicates last wins): no leniency left; NAMED stricter: net/http refuses a header line with no colon or a 'From ' line (rc1, request failed) where Python skips it or ends the headers

NAMED: a Location with brackets in its netloc: Python raises ValueError (traceback, rc1, stderr), Go reports the mismatch (rc1, stdout). urljoin is ported for https references (dot segments, interior empty segments, https: forms); fragments and queries always mismatch as in Python (trailing whitespace of Location is kept, as Python)
